:::{#exr-overfitting}
#### Training error versus error on new cars

The built-in `mtcars` data frame has $n = 32$ cars.
Fit four models for fuel efficiency `mpg` as a polynomial in weight `wt`,
of degree 1, 2, 3, and 4,
using only the first 20 rows as the training set.
For each model, compute the root mean squared error (RMSE)
on the 20 training rows
and on the remaining 12 rows.

1. Which degree has the smallest training RMSE?
2. Which degree has the smallest RMSE on the 12 held-out rows?
3. Is the model with the smallest training RMSE
   also the best predictor for the held-out cars?

:::
